label: US / EAS & Wireless Emergency Alerts
description: Broadcast and mobile public warnings, including national and local messages. FEMA’s public IPAWS archive is delayed 24 hours; it cannot establish current alert status. Live IPAWS feed access must be arranged through FEMA.

label: Japan / J-Alert
description: Rapid warnings include ballistic missiles, earthquakes and major tsunamis. This official overview explains delivery to phones and municipal broadcasts; its sample messages are not active warnings.

label: South Korea / Safe Korea
description: Public emergency messages can be browsed by location. A municipal safety message is not a nationwide military alert. The English portal warns that its automated translations may contain errors.

label: China / Shanghai warning system
description: Official rules describe local hazard warnings, red/orange/yellow/blue grades and the 12379 messaging channel. This is a Shanghai policy reference, not a live China-wide warning feed.

label: US / National Weather Service
description: Public machine-readable weather alerts are available through the NWS API. Weather alerts are geographically bounded and do not represent military readiness or all emergency broadcasts.
